reflections.summary: Lost because the team-preview plan was fundamentally flawed. Archaludon was brought despite Gholdengo's Focus Blast being a guaranteed OHKO, and it died on turn 1 without acting. Politoed's rain + Hydro Pump was unreliable (missed Azumarill T2), and the remaining three mons had no answer to Trick Room Azumarill. Scizor-Mega at 95 Spe is awkward under TR—too slow to outspeed outside it, too fast to benefit inside it. The four brought and the Mega choice did not suit this opponent's TR + Gholdengo
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Archaludon into a team with Life Orb Gholdengo Focus Blast—it is a guaranteed sack. Lead Scizor-Mega alongside a TR answer; prioritize Farigiraf removal to unblock Bullet Punch priority. Consider a different Mega or a bulkier four that can survive TR turns without relying on speed control that loses to TR.
reflections.notebook: Series lost 0-2. Opponent Protect-reads well and punishes consecutive Protects. Archaludon is unviable vs this team. Scizor-Mega struggles under TR speed tier. Politoed Hydro Pump 80% acc too unreliable. Key lesson: respect TR + priority-block + Huge Power Azumarill; need dedicated TR counterplay, not rain synergy that folds to Focus Blast.

reflections.adjustment: Next game, avoid unnecessary Life Orb recoil on Gholdengo by using Protect or switching when low HP; also, factor in Politoed's Sitrus Berry when calculating damage thresholds to secure KOs more reliably.
